findings.case: a later hand cast uses only prior command-zone casts
findings.limitation: This diagnoses existing engine behavior; it does not endorse the existing CommanderZoneChoiceCheck hand/library treatment as rules-correct or qualify full commander lifecycle.
findings.mechanism: Fixture manually attaches CommanderComponent to card already in hand with no CommanderZoneChoiceAskedComponent. Standalone Palace mana activation settles at activation priority; CommanderZoneChoiceCheck includes HAND and pauses with leave-in-hand/command-zone decision. Cast while this decision is pending is rejected for no priority.
findings.minimal_repair: After activation, assert exact pending commander-zone yes/no decision belongs to this commander/owner, submit false through real decision API, assert success/no pending decision/actor priority/card still hand, then perform unchanged cast and expected two counters. Do not overwrite priority or silently swallow arbitrary decisions.

cases: two Palace mana spent on a first command-zone cast add two counters
two Palace contributions are combined before an additive counter modifier
findings.mechanism: AddManaOfChoiceExecutor stores rider-bearing Palace mana as restrictedMana with AnySpend, so it is eligible for all costs. Second Palace activation costs {1}; autoTapForManaCost first calls pool.payPartial and finds the first Palace unit covers the cost, so no extra Plains is tapped. payAbilityCost consumes that unit; second activation replaces it with one new rider unit. Commander therefore legitimately receives one Palace contribution; with Hardened Scales it receives two counters. These observations do not demonstrate broken aggregation.
findings.minimal_repair_requirement: Make both Palace units demonstrably remain in pool and actually be spent on commander. Add pre-cast assertion of exactly two CommanderCastEntryCounters units and on-stack aggregate2, retaining original final2/final3 assertions. Merely adding more Plains, pre-floating ordinary mana, or choosing PaymentStrategy.Explicit does not solve current restricted-first policy: Explicit also calls payPartial before source selection.
options: For the same real two-activation trace, expose/receive a bounded legitimate mana-spend selection that pays second activation with ordinary mana while retaining first rider. This is a separate shared payment capability/source change requiring its own targeted authority.

A source-reviewed prospective mechanic fixture may initialize a documented two-unit Palace-rider pool to isolate aggregation, preserving both contribution assertions and final endpoints; this changes setup scope and requires explicit prospective bank amendment. It cannot be represented as proof of two actual Palace activations or complete payment behavior.

no_weakenings: Do not lower expected counters to1/2 or drop cases.
Do not rerun seven successful cases on unchanged source.
Do not infer production aggregation defect solely from wrong fixture payment precondition.
Preserve original7pass/3fail raw outcomes and consumed attempt.
